result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with fragmented, discontinuous sidewalks and a complete lack of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. Pedestrians must navigate unpaved gaps between sidewalk sections and cross the street without designated protection or guidance.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: Sidewalks are fragmented and do not reach the intersection, forcing pedestrians onto the grass or road.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: No marked crossing areas exist at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians unprotected.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes at the corner may hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Complete the sidewalk network to provide a continuous, safe walking surface separated from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a residential setting with a marked zebra crosswalk and basic street lighting. However, the wide roadway lacks a median refuge, and large piles of trash bags on the sidewalk create physical and visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags are placed on the sidewalk and verge, forcing pedestrians to deviate from their path and potentially blocking sight lines.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases pedestrian exposure time to vehicle traffic without the protection of a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway that creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide multi-lane roadway without any mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: The wide lanes and large intersection footprint encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the risk and severity of potential conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: The broad expanse of the intersection roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane signalized intersection that is heavily prioritized for vehicle throughput and lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure. There are no visible marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or sidewalks, creating a highly hostile environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks exist to define a safe path for pedestrians or to alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires a long exposure time for any pedestrian attempting to cross multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no dedicated signal phase or indication of when it is safe to cross relative to vehicle movements.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signalization
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and leading pedestrian intervals (LPI).

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Modify the existing median to include protected cut-throughs for pedestrians to wait safely mid-crossing.
